note: FNS 1161.4 applies exclusively to monthly reporting households that fail to report actual utility expenses on their monthly report. Massachusetts does not use monthly reporting as a SNAP certification type. The OLG's Certification Type Overview page lists four certification types: Change Reporting, Simplified Reporting, Bay State CAP, and TBA — none of which is monthly reporting. Since Massachusetts has no monthly reporting households, this FNS requirement has no practical application in MA and the OLG has no obligation to cover it. The OLG does address analogous scenarios for its own reporting systems — e.g., the 'Processing of Unverified Expense Deductions' section covers what happens when households fail to verify expenses at application, recertification, IR, and during certification periods, and the 'Verification of Utility Expenses' section addresses TBA and SR households specifically.
